preconditions.description: The first line of input contains an integer T representing the number of testcases, where T is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each testcase, N is a positive integer representing the length of the binary string.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, str) and len(S) == N and all(c in '01' for c in S) for S, N in zip(S_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each testcase, S is a binary string of length N containing only '0' and '1'.
The sum of lengths of all binary strings across testcases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each testcase.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a single non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max_01_occurrences(S_list[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each testcase i, the output integer equals the maximum possible number of '01' substrings achievable by swapping characters at indices of the same parity in the input string S.
